# C1 — Folding-fin mechanism model

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | **CONTRADICTED** — Current evidence contradicts the claim or one of its requirements. |
| Strongest accepted evidence | MODEL ONLY |
| Evidence classes cited | IMPLEMENTATION, TEST PROCEDURE, ANALYTICAL |
| Gate reached | ANALYTICAL MODEL (next: SOFTWARE REPRODUCTION) |
| Last review | CURRENT — snapshot recorded 2026-09-28 by tooling snapshot (no human review) |

**Question.** Can the specified four-bar linkage carry the fin from folded (0 deg) to 92 deg and hold it over-center?

**Current statement.** In the planar model, the specified baseline linkage (ground 25, coupler 60, input 15, output 15 mm) cannot close at any drive angle from 0 to 92 deg, and none of the 81 swept variants can. Transmission-angle and envelope requirements therefore cannot be evaluated, and over-center locking is not modeled.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Check | Bound | Observed | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-C1-CLOSURE | The baseline linkage closes (assembles) at every drive angle from 0 to 92 deg. | machine | = true | false | NOT SATISFIED (analytical) |
| R-C1-TRANSMISSION | The transmission angle stays within 40-140 deg throughout deployment. | machine | ≥ 40 and ≤ 140 deg | artifact reports no value (null means no value exists) | NOT EVALUABLE (analytical) |
| R-C1-LOCK | The over-center toggle holds the fin at the deployed position against the design hinge moment. | physical measurement | none stated | NOT MEASURED | NOT MEASURED |

## Open questions

- Which topology and dimensions were intended? The recorded dimensions cannot form a closed loop (D-002).

## Discrepancies

- [D-002](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-002) (OPEN) The specified four-bar cannot be assembled
- [D-004](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-004) (OPEN) Over-center locking is claimed but not modeled
- [D-005](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-005) (OPEN) C1 CAD artifacts are illustrative bars, not the modeled mechanism
- [D-001](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-001) (RESOLVED) Historical C1 note contradicts its own sweep
- [D-003](../DISCREPANCIES.md#d-003) (RESOLVED) C1 model revision 1 reported placeholders as results, and its tests passed on them

## Assumptions

- The mechanism is a planar, pin-jointed four-bar loop.
- Link lengths are pin-centre distances in millimetres.
- The drive angle is measured from the folded position.

## Limitations

- A planar model cannot tell whether a different topology or pivot layout was intended.
- Loop geometry says nothing about loads, clearance, compliance, or locking torque.
- Rendered or exported CAD of the links is not evidence that the mechanism assembles.

## Measurement needed to close the next gate

- Reviewer confirmation of the intended link dimensions and topology.
- A revised, reviewed model; only then an inert, instrumented deployment test of a printed linkage.

## Pre-registered experiments

- None.

## What this claim does not establish

- Any inert physical measurement: none has been accepted for this claim.
- Physical performance of any hardware.
- Flight readiness or safety for live propulsion.
